record_title: Stable integral Cartan forms under singular equivalence of centralizer matrix algebras
provenance: Scientific theorem, proof, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The singular-equivalence invariant is proved only for centralizer matrix algebras, not arbitrary finite-dimensional algebras.
The integral diagonalization is known from Li--Xi; the new contribution is its stable singular-equivalence consequence, the Cartan-group refinement, and the nilpotent-centralizer realization.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; an equivalent short consequence may exist under different Cartan-cokernel or integral-form terminology.
